Hand weeding

______ is a measure of the amount of water delivered by irrigation that actually ends up as available water to the plant.

Tillage

______ refers to seeds while planting is used when vegetative parts are involved.
terms sowing

final percentage emergence

Uncontrolled burning

______ refers to those measures necessary to prevent the introduction of new weed species into a given geographical area as well as multiplication and spread of existing weed species.
Preventive weed control

______ are those that will preferentially kill certain plants species at recommended rates but will not harm other plants that they come in contact with.
Selective herbicides

fruit

important cultural practiced

testa
